reading: The ink sketches a full design-tool interface: a dark toolbar across the top, a 'LAYERS' list panel on the left, a blank canvas frame in the middle (labeled 'Desktop') holding a gradient hero tile with a 'Noor' badge, a selected black pill button with its resize handles and dimension label, and a grey skeleton text bar, plus a detailed 'inspector' panel on the right. All the specific colors, sizes and content come from the typed notes anchored to each piece.
